summary: First full test run of the pivoted Atelier Ink & Steel luxury pen e-commerce app. Ran 18 pytest backend tests (all passed) covering products list/filters/facets/detail, auth (admin+customer register/login/me), admin role protection (401/403), admin product CRUD, image upload + fetch via /api/files/, guest and authenticated checkout session creation returning real Stripe checkout URL, payment status polling, customer /orders/mine, admin /admin/orders and PATCH shipment. Frontend e2e via Playwright covered: Home hero + 5 category tiles + 4 featured cards, /shop catalog grid + Rollerball filter + sort dropdown, Silver Dragon Roller PDP (correctly shows $499 with $1288 strikethrough and 61% discount label), Add-to-cart opens cart drawer with correct subtotal, checkout form submission redirects to real https://checkout.stripe.com URL (guest checkout works), admin login redirects to /admin, dashboard/products/orders tabs render, Orders tab lists the just-created order.

issues: Discount badge on PDP reads 'SAVE 61%' — task spec expected '−61%' formatting like the catalog card badge. Purely cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~730 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting routers (auth/products/admin/payments) into separate modules.

/api/orders/lookup uses email exact match with .lower() but shipping.email is stored as provided (Pydantic EmailStr preserves case) — case-mismatch could cause false 404s. Consider normalising email at write time.

In payment_status endpoint, StripeCheckout is instantiated with a placeholder webhook_url='https://example.com/...'; if the library validates or uses it, this is fragile. Suggest reusing origin from request or a configured PUBLIC_BASE_URL env.

Stock decrement happens only via /payments/status polling and webhook, not atomically with session creation — race condition possible if stock is limited (e.g. Aurora Limited stock=4). Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
test_credentials: admin@atelier.pens / Admin@123456 (seeded). Customer test users created dynamically via /register.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — a few TEST_* orders created via guest+authenticated checkout during flow tests, and a couple of TEST products created and deleted via admin CRUD tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. E2E happy path from Home -> Shop -> PDP -> Cart -> Checkout -> Stripe redirect works. Admin login -> /admin -> Orders tab confirmed. If retesting, note that test file uses load_dotenv on frontend/.env to obtain REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL because pytest env doesn't export it. Stripe redirect was verified by observing page.url change to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...; actual card payment was not performed (per instructions).
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues found in this iteration.
